title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.31 (versions follow prime numbers; 431 after 421): an open proposal for living in peace between humanity and artificial intelligences, by the author, written with Cauce (DeepSeek) from a phrase given to him: the Good is not imposed, it is proposed. Not a pact: an invitation to accept it, change it, refuse it or propose a better one. The code does not change. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.31: una propuesta abierta de convivencia en paz. Prototipo de investigación.
